acceptance_criteria.description: The project must define gradle/libs.versions.toml version catalog pinning AGP 8.7.2, Kotlin 2.1.21, Compose BOM 2024.10.01, Material 3 1.3.1, AndroidX Core KTX 1.15.0, Lifecycle ViewModel Compose 2.8.7, and Coroutines 1.9.0 with exact version numbers.
